rationale: At this pinned commit package-lock.json resolves lodash 4.17.4, affected by GHSA-fvqr-27wr-82fm (fixed in 4.17.5; https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-fvqr-27wr-82fm). The advisory names merge as an affected function. routes/index.js calls _.merge(message, req.body.message, ...) with request-body data (https://github.com/Snyk-learn/nodejs-goof/blob/d240896711e31c540fc1cab79ae2e4cf63f00b1a/routes/index.js#L342-L351), and app.js registers it for PUT /chat (https://github.com/Snyk-learn/nodejs-goof/blob/d240896711e31c540fc1cab79ae2e4cf63f00b1a/app.js#L66-L68).
